articles.title: Forecasting space weather risks on power grids
articles.summary: Extreme space-weather events can damage power systems on Earth and degrade GPS accuracy and satellite operations. A new machine learning system can predict where damage is likely to occur 30-60 minutes before a storm arrives.
articles.author: Rohan Kannan

articles.title: Introducing Quine: An AI research system designed for the complexity of biology
articles.summary: Biology doesn't operate in silos, and neither should the AI representation of it. Quine is an early-stage research effort to create a multimodal world model of biology. By connecting insights across biological scales and modalities, Quine helps scientists computationally search a space far larger than intuition allows and prioritize hypotheses before they reach the lab. Experimental results provide important feedback, helping researchers sharpen future research directions.
articles.author: Nicolo Fusi, Jonathan M. Carlson

articles.title: One year in: How Microsoft Research Asia – Singapore is advancing research, partnership and talent for real-world impact
articles.summary: Since launching a year ago, the Microsoft Research Asia — Singapore lab has established a strong foundation, deepened collaboration across government, academia, and industry, and explored how frontier AI research can create real-world value.
articles.author: Microsoft Research Team

articles.title: Offloaded inference for real-world physical AI robotics
articles.summary: Robots are getting smarter, but how can their hardware match that growth? New Microsoft Research findings show that moving AI inference beyond the robot can improve task success, boost efficiency, and support more advanced physical AI workloads.
articles.author: Ganesh Ananthanarayanan, Matthew Balkwill, Xenofon Foukas, Sanjeev Mehrotra, Bozidar Radunovic, Connor Settle, Ankit Verma, David White, Shawn Cicoria, Mark Martin, Rachel Johnson, Mayur Patel

articles.title: Improving synthesis prediction of small molecules at scale with RetroChimera
articles.summary: Custom-made molecules are advancing medicine, materials, and agriculture, but producing them is slow and expensive. A new Nature paper highlights RetroChimera, a predictive model that helps accelerate chemical synthesis, helping researchers explore a wide range of molecules.
articles.author: Felix Pultar, John Gardner, Guoqing Liu, Marwin Segler

articles.title: GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash: Toward population-scale discovery with efficient pathology foundation models
articles.summary: What if pathology foundation models could do more with less? GigaPath-Flash and GigaTIME-Flash cut computational demands while maintaining strong performance, opening the door to larger studies and broader exploration.
articles.author: Naoto Usuyama, Jeya Maria Jose Valanarasu, Tristan Naumann

articles.title: Broadening access to Skala creates a faster path to predictive DFT
articles.summary: Skala 1.1, the updated deep-learning exchange-correlation functional from Microsoft Research, provides greater accuracy, expanded accessibility across the computational chemistry ecosystem, and a living benchmark to track computational performance.
articles.author: Sebastian Ehlert, Stefano Battaglia, Thijs Vogels, Jan Hermann, Jens Wehner, Giulia Luise, Klaas Giesbertz, Chin-Wei Huang, Aaron Kaplan, Kate Milton, Stephanie Marisa Lanius, Derk Kooi, P. Bernát Szabó, Gregor Simm, Rianne van den Berg, Paola Gori Giorgi

articles.title: MindTopo reveals VLMs’ spatial reasoning abilities
articles.summary: A path, a fence, a knot. MindTopo sets a new benchmark for testing how AI understands topological relationships and highlights new opportunities to strengthen spatial reasoning and planning.
articles.author: Yunfei Ge, Anbang Liu, Qineng Wang, Johnalbert Garnica, Zihan Wang, Reuben Tan, Jianfeng Gao, Ruohan Zhang, Yining Hong, Jiajun Wu, Manling Li

articles.title: Introducing CARE-X: Towards Clinically Useful Radiology VLMs with Auxiliary Supervision, Reward-Aligned Learning, and Tool-Augmented Measurement
articles.summary: Radiology AI is evolving beyond report generation. CARE-X explores a unified approach that combines flexible reasoning, calibrated predictions, and measurement-based tools for chest X-ray interpretation.
articles.author: Mercy Ranjit, Nikhilesh E, Dr. Abhyuday Kumara  Swamy, Tanuja Ganu

articles.title: Orchard: An open framework for scalable agentic AI
articles.summary: Orchard is an open-source framework for the research community to train and evaluate AI agents across task types. It reduces complexity while supporting strong performance from smaller models by enabling researchers to reuse the same infrastructure.
articles.author: Baolin Peng, Wenlin Yao, Qianhui Wu, Hao Cheng, Jianfeng Gao
